ai_analysis.executive_summary: Target system has critical vulnerabilities requiring immediate remediation.
ai_analysis.technical_summary: SAST and secret scanners detected SQL injection and exposed cryptographic material.
ai_analysis.risk_prioritization:
P0: Invalidate JWT keys
P0: Fix SQL Injection
ai_analysis.remediation_playbook:
1. Invalidate compromised JWT keys.
2. Apply parameterized queries across all database access layers.
ai_analysis.false_positive_analysis: All findings verified with high confidence.

correlated_risks.title: Authentication Bypass via Exposed JWT Key & SQL Injection
correlated_risks.description: Combined attack chain allows complete system compromise.
correlated_risks.explanation: Attacker crafts token with leaked key and queries sensitive data using SQL injection.
correlated_risks.attack_scenario: Attacker signs admin token -> accesses privileged endpoint -> exploits SQLi -> dumps database.
correlated_risks.remediation: Rotate key immediately and parameterize database queries.

findings.title: SQL Injection in User Search Query
findings.description: Dynamic SQL concatenation allows authentication bypass.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized prepared statements with bind parameters.
findings.threat_scenario: Attacker supplies crafted SQL payloads to bypass authentication and dump customer records.

potential_impact.business_impact: Severe data breach violating GDPR and PCI-DSS.

findings.title: Exposed JWT Private Signing Key
findings.description: Private RSA key found hardcoded in repository.
findings.remediation: Rotate compromised key and store in cloud KMS vault.
findings.threat_scenario: Leaked cryptographic key allows forgery of valid session tokens with admin claims.

potential_impact.business_impact: Full account takeover across all tenants.
